citation.authors: Donata, Kesavan M, Austin, et al

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: 10 patients with vitiligo given an ayurvedic preparation by mouth and a herbal paste on the skin
record.design: Small clinical trial (comparison group not described in the abstract)
record.finding: Four of 10 had relief within six months, three had relief with an adverse skin reaction, and the rest did not respond.
record.note: Very small and old; no control group described in the abstract, so it cannot show the preparation works. The paste included Psoralea corylifolia.
